reflection.delta: Public inspection semantics were initially missing; isolated review exposed collision-prone controller identity keys, mixed raw/JSON fetch-sync revision keys, naive metadata-key splitting, and a projection-failure path that could leave active preview revisions unchanged. The first collision correction also missed one membership lookup.
reflection.root_cause: Production tasks intentionally preceded documentation, internal maps reused the human-readable type:id display format inconsistently, legacy metadata keys were parsed without consulting actual graph buckets, and preview conflict tracking depended on successful semantic event projection. The first collision fix updated map writers but overlooked one record-projection reader.
corrective_actions: Added package, changelog, skills, API, security, and verification content derived from production source.
Regenerated and verified the built core runtime ledger without altering root exports.
Recursively validated receipt statuses and recomputed byte-identical fixture hashes.
Replaced controller-owned composite map keys with collision-free JSON-encoded identities and added an assembled adversarial case.
Used the failing full rerun to find and correct the missed membership reader, then reran the complete packed gate successfully.
Added a controller-wide failure epoch so an unprojectable publication invalidates active preview restores, plus an assembled adversarial scenario proving fail-closed behavior.
Resolved legacy metadata keys against actual entity/patch buckets before fallback parsing and used the collision-free identity for every entity revision update.
Bound every claim to this change and named the remaining downstream work.

constraint_evaluation.notes: The built verifier reports 128 unchanged root exports and exactly 7 ./devtools exports matching the committed ledger.
Public content matches the source contracts for projections, registrations, relationships, revisions, preview, restore, and lifecycle.
The security receipt distinguishes hidden values from visible identifiers/topology and assigns authorization to the host transport.
All recursive acceptance statuses pass; 16 scenarios are present; both fixtures are byte-identical at the retained SHA-256.
The public reference, verification receipt, and QA report exclude every downstream DevTools and publication change.

reflection.deterministic_validation: Pass after one observed corrective regression. The runtime ledger, expanded 16-scenario packed receipt, fixture equality/hash, and diff whitespace checks passed.
reflection.target_alignment: The archive packet now states the implemented contract and its limits without expanding the phase frontier.
reflection.regression_check: The first corrective rerun exposed and prevented a membership regression. The final gate has no failing status; no root runtime export or fixture byte changed, and no downstream completion claim was introduced.

convergence.rationale: All five blocking constraints pass; no further content delta improves truthfulness, security clarity, or traceability.
